title: Medallion of flight
description: A paper plugin which adds a craftable medallion which enables survival players to fly.
body:
![Recipe consisting of four diamond blocks one in each corner, a central elytra which is surrounded by four netherstars](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd242398e416003102ddc3f72bb353f2830f024a.png)

A paper plugin which adds a craftable medallion to enable flight for survival.

Inspired by the spigot plugin of the same name by doopaderp. Great end-game item which acts as an incentive for players but also avoidable for those who prefer a vanilla experience.
